rulingsR3.d3InMotion: REJECTED. Viewed live, the gapped attempt (S2 b3), the stepped thinning (S2 b4), and the faded remnant at the birth (S3 b1) all read as rendering defects, not as a path failing. Formally reopened: s2-b3-a’s path element, s2-b4-c, and s3-b1’s remnant — the path element within these states only; the compositions around them are NOT reopened. Replacements are judged live as runtime candidates (?proto=gate2&path=1|2|3); the presenter’s selection re-enters the approved record at the gate close. Binding principle for all candidates: no degraded stroke ever appears in a settled frame — failure is carried by motion, by absence, or by a medium that is not a line.
rulingsR3.spendGoods: s4-b2-b’s goods layout is reopened with an explicit markup: the three renders are too large and reach into the frame’s center. The fix is direct (no candidates): reduced uniform scale, a compact triangle within the spend terminal’s zone, wholly inside the frame’s left third. The legacy spend arrangement (ref-4-05-b2) is studied for containment and modesty, not copied. Re-rendered through the states pipeline as s4-b2-b2 beside the reopened original.
